name: Dew Needle (Lộ Châm)

arts.name: Dew Prick (Lộ Châm Thích)
arts.rule: A fine needle of water: a quick Water hit that gives you 1 Water stack for 8 s.

lore: A needle that draws morning dew from the air; Water sects give it to disciples who learn to breathe.
build_use: The Deep Sea's first weapon: a cheap, quick art that keeps a Water stack up before the công pháp arts arrive.

name: Dewdrop Ring (Lộ Châu Giới)
lore: A silver band with a bead of water that never dries and never falls.
build_use: Any Water build's early ring: a deeper pool and faster breathing.

name: Still-Pool Gourd (Tĩnh Trì Hồ Lô)

arts.name: Gourd Pours the Pool (Hồ Lô Khuynh Trì)
arts.rule: The gourd tips out a pool: a Water hit that gives you 2 Water stacks for 10 s. With 6 Water stacks it pours three of them out as a hit 2.2 times as hard.

lore: A gourd that was never emptied; every sip leaves the pool exactly as full.
build_use: The Deep Sea: turns a built-up Water stack pile into a heavy hit, and Steady Breath pays while the pool stays above half.

name: Tide Bell (Triều Chung)

wards.name: Rolling Tide Ward (Cuồn Triều Tráo)
wards.notes: The starter ward at 1.5 times its payload and its per-hit payment, so the price check is unchanged (2.935 of 3.050)

lore: Harbour sects ring it as a tide turns; the sound rolls over the wearer and softens blows.
build_use: The Crushing Tide: a stronger per-hit ward for a build that takes few, heavy hits while it saves for its wave.

name: Moon-Well Pendant (Tỉnh Nguyệt Bội)

reserve_arts.name: Still Surface (Tĩnh Diện Quang)
reserve_arts.rule: While reserved, your Water buff stacks last 25 % longer and are 10 % stronger.
reserve_arts.notes: Priced by Formulas I reserve arts: 10 % reserved buys up to 10 W

lore: A pale jade disc that holds a reflection of the moon even at noon.
build_use: The Deep Sea and The Moon in the Well: a standing upgrade to Water stacks paid in linh lực, not an art slot.

name: Drowned Anchor (Trầm Hải Mao)

arts.name: Anchor Falls on the Tide (Mao Trầm Triều)
arts.rule: Counts as a Still Moon Tide Scripture art. A slow, heavy Water drop; every Water art you fire adds a Tide (twice a pulse at most). With 3 Tide, and either the Deep Lake or 4 Water stacks, the anchor falls 2.5 times as hard and spends the 3 Tide.

lore: Dragged up from a drowned harbour, its chain still wet; the Still Moon lineage's arts answer to it.
build_use: The Crushing Tide: a fifth Tide source and a heavy finisher the Still Moon Tide Scripture counts, without learning another technique.

name: Brimming Shield (Mãn Thuẫn)

wards.name: Layered Cloud (Trùng Vân)
wards.notes: The starter ward at 1.5 times its shield and its reservation, so the price check is unchanged (3.031 of 3.050)

lore: A round shield of water held in a frame of cold bronze; it is always brimming, never spilling.
build_use: The Overflowing Cup: a big standing shield for a pool that stays full, and Steady Breath pays for it.

name: Ring of the Returning Tide (Hồi Triều Giới)

effects.name: Backflow (Hồi Lưu Triều)
effects.rule: When you restore health with an art, you regain linh lực equal to 20 % of the health restored, at most 3 % of your maximum linh lực a pulse.
effects.reads: Health restored by your arts, live
effects.from: single-water.md, The Deep Sea and The Overflowing Cup (heals feeding the pool)
effects.status: in effects.md (approved by the user 2026-11-13; accepted 2026-11-12)

lore: A ring of salt-white silver; what the sea takes from its wearer, it returns.
build_use: The Overflowing Cup and Tide builds: every heal refills the pool, so Water's healing arts pay for the next art.

name: Mirror of the Drowned Moon (Nịch Nguyệt Kính)

effects.name: Sea Already Deep (Hải Dĩ Thâm)
effects.rule: You begin every fight with 8 Water buff stacks that last the whole fight.
effects.payload: Water buff stacks for the fight
effects.closes: Your arts cost 10 % more linh lực.
effects.from: single-water.md, The Deep Sea (the pool is deep from t = 0)
effects.status: in effects.md (approved by the user 2026-11-13; accepted 2026-11-12)

reserve_arts.name: Reflection (Ảnh Quang)
reserve_arts.rule: While reserved, the foe's blows strike a reflection: you gain 6 points of evade.
reserve_arts.notes: Priced by Formulas I reserve arts: 15 % reserved buys up to 15 W; this spends 9 W

holder: A Nascent Soul Water cultivator of an illusion-leaning sect, otherwise Lost at the bottom of a drowned-moon lake
lore: A bronze mirror that sank with the moon's reflection still in it; its wearer starts every fight already in deep water.
build_use: The Deep Sea and The Moon in the Well: the sea is deep from the first pulse, and the reflection turns blows aside.

name: Nine-Fathom Abyss Seal (Cửu Tầm Uyên Ấn)

arts.name: Abyss Seal Descends (Uyên Ấn Trụy)
arts.rule: Counts as an Undertow Litany art. A slow Water seal that adds a Slowed Time stack and delays the foe's slowest-ready art by 1 s. With 4 Slowed Time on the foe and two Undertow Litany arts fired in the last second, it drops four and a half times as hard and delays every art of the foe by 1.5 s.

holder: A Nascent Soul Water or Ice cultivator who keeps to a deep-sea sect; otherwise Lost in a flooded secret realm
lore: Carved from a stone that fell into the sea nine fathoms past where light reaches; it still sinks.
build_use: The Moon in the Well and slowing builds: the litany's keystone seal, and Water Table turns a foe's drain wards into the wearer's pool.

name: Undertow Mail (Ám Lưu Giáp)

wards.name: Undertow Ward (Ám Lưu Tráo)
wards.notes: The Common Ward at 0.6 times its payload and its drain, so the price check is unchanged (3.049 of 3.050)

lore: Scale-plate of dark blue lacquer; the water inside it moves against every blow.
build_use: A standing drain ward the engine can run, paid from the Water pool: a Water body armour for builds that wear a ward all fight.
notes: Answers: pacifist: a Water armour (Giáp) with a standing ward; unique-nine-fathom-seal: a Water body armour; starter-tide: a Water armour with a pool ward. Ward factor 0.6 of the Common Ward.

name: Owed Water Pendant (Thiếu Thủy Bội)

effects.name: Owed Water (Thiếu Thủy)
effects.rule: When your linh lực falls to 20 % of maximum or below, you regain 15 % of your maximum linh lực over the next 5 s. Once every 20 s.
effects.from: dry-well (linh lực debt repaid to the wearer); starter-tide (a non-reserve Water necklace Effect)
effects.status: in effects.md (approved by the user 2026-11-13; accepted 2026-11-12, patch 2026-11-13)

lore: A pendant the sea lends against and always collects back; it repays whoever runs dry.
build_use: Builds that run dry before the foe: a pool refill that is not a reserve art.
notes: Answers: dry-well: Owed Water, linh lực debt repaid to the wearer; dry-well: a Water necklace with sustain that is not a reserve art; starter-tide: a Water necklace with a non-reserve Effect.

name: Slack Tide Ring (Hoãn Triều Giới)
lore: A plain tin ring that leaves the wearer's fingers a little cold; curses hung with it cling.
build_use: Slowing and thrifty Water builds: a cheap ring that keeps Slowed Time on the foe and trims Water art costs.
notes: Answers: unique-nine-fathom-seal: a cheap grade-1 slow item (Slowed Time duration); pacifist: a cost-reducing item (Water art cost).

name: Underground Spring Censer (Địa Tuyền Hương Lô)

effects.name: Brimming Cup (Mãn Bôi)
effects.rule: Linh lực lost to a full pool fills your Cup: you gain 1 Water buff stack for 8 s for every 5 % of maximum linh lực lost, at most 2 stacks a pulse.
effects.reads: Linh lực lost to a full pool, live
effects.from: starter-tide (a full pool turned into a Cup refill)
effects.status: in effects.md (approved by the user 2026-11-13; accepted 2026-11-12, patch 2026-11-13)

reserve_arts.name: Underground Spring (Địa Tuyền)
reserve_arts.rule: While reserved, a spring feeds your pool: your linh lực regenerates 8 % faster and your Water buff stacks last 10 % longer.
reserve_arts.notes: Priced by Formulas I reserve arts: 10 % reserved buys up to 10 W; this spends 8.4 W

lore: Incense that smells of wet stone; the smoke runs down, not up, to where a spring is.
build_use: The Overflowing Cup: a full pool spills into Water stacks, and the spring keeps it full.
notes: Answers: starter-tide: a Water extra-slot piece that turns a full pool into a Cup refill; unkillable: a Water buff or spring item (Underground Spring).
